title: Equipment — Fwd Cargo Hold — Installation of Noise Attenuation Blankets

issue.reason: Issue C. Earlier issues are not held in this dataset.

abstract: Installation of quilted attenuation blankets behind the forward cargo hold lining on delivered aircraft, to remove the measured sound level step in the cabin rows directly above the compartment.

sections.planning_reason: Cabin sound surveys showed a 3 to 5 dBA step in the seat rows above the forward cargo hold compared with equivalent rows further aft, traced to structure-borne excitation of the lower shell reaching the cabin floor through an essentially untreated void. Three launch customers raised the same observation within a year of entry into service. The change is a comfort improvement rather than a defect correction and is offered as a customer option.
sections.description: Quilted attenuation blankets are fitted in the void behind the forward hold ceiling and upper sidewall lining. The blankets are captured by the existing lining fasteners and by additional blind rivets into the lining rails, so no new structural attachment is created. The lining panel is replaced by a version with a moulded return that traps the blanket edge, and the compartment light standoff is lengthened so that the lens stays flush with the new lining line.
sections.accomplishment_summary: Empty the forward cargo compartment and remove the cargo nets. Remove the ceiling and upper sidewall lining panels in zones 111, 113 and 116. Vacuum the void and inspect the structure and the drain path for existing damage; report any finding before continuing. Install the attenuation blankets to the layout in the accomplishment instructions, starting at the aft end of the compartment. Install the replacement lining panels D2550113609050 with the moulded return, using blind rivets LN181986-9B into the lining rails. Install the light assembly D2550118482429 with the longer standoff and check that the lens is flush. Do a smoke detection air flow check of the compartment. Refit the trim 9911DL and the cargo nets. Update the cargo volume figure in the aircraft loading document and record the embodiment.
sections.effectivity_note: Applicable to MRD-42K1 and MRD-46K1 aircraft from MSN M00001 through M00276 that are still pre MOD-161204. Aircraft from the production cut-in onward already carry the blankets. Freighter aircraft are not covered.
sections.material_note: Kit K2550-1130-01 contains the blanket set, the replacement lining panels, the light standoffs and the fastener content. Lead time is fourteen weeks. Revision 03 splits the kit into a forward and an aft half so that operators can do the compartment over two visits; the material note in earlier revisions did not allow this.

type_data.compliance_time: At the operator's convenience, normally during a scheduled cabin visit.

revision_history.reason: Smoke detection air flow check added after the compartment flow test campaign
Kit split into forward and aft halves to allow embodiment over two visits
